modern: Every single thing is accomplished in keeping with the nature of the universe; for certainly it is not in keeping with any other nature that each thing is accomplished, whether a nature which contains this one from outside, or a nature which is contained within this nature, or a nature external to and independent of this one.
original: In conformity to the nature of the universe every single thing is accomplished; for certainly it is not in conformity to any other nature that each thing is accomplished, either a nature which externally comprehends this, or a nature which is comprehended within this nature, or a nature external and independent of this.
notification: Every single thing is accomplished in keeping with the nature of the universe;
